title: Polynomial-time three-machine unit-job scheduling
exact_target: For any explicitly listed finite acyclic precedence graph on unit-length nonpreemptive jobs, can one deterministic polynomial-bit-time algorithm produce a minimum-makespan schedule on three identical machines and decide every binary deadline exactly?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
